title: Pork meatballs with chipotle aïoli
steps: Prep. Preheat oven to 400°F. Halve onion; save one half for another use and small dice the other (1/4 inch). Small dice tomato (1/4 inch). Roughly chop cabbage and carrots if needed. Zest the whole lime into a medium bowl, then quarter the lime.
Season and form meatballs. In a second bowl, mix pork, spice blend, half the diced onion, about 1 tbsp chipotle aïoli, 1/4 tsp salt and a pinch of pepper. Form 8 to 10 meatballs, about 1 inch.
Toast pepitas in a dry medium sauté pan over medium heat, 2 to 3 min, shaking often. Set aside; keep the pan.
Cook meatballs on a lightly oiled foil-lined baking sheet at 400°F for 16 to 18 min, until 160°F inside.

Cauliflower rice. In the same pan, heat a drizzle of oil over medium. Add cauliflower and the remaining onion, the cumin-coriander-oregano blend, 1/4 tsp salt and a pinch of pepper. Cook 4 to 5 min until tender.
Slaw. Add tomato and cabbage-carrot mix to the bowl with lime zest. Drizzle with olive oil, squeeze in 1 to 2 lime wedges, toss, season.
Plate. Cauliflower rice, meatballs, drizzle with remaining aïoli, slaw on the side, pepitas on top, remaining lime wedges.

title: Chicken and tomato couscous skillet
steps: Prep. Thinly slice olives into rounds. Quarter lemon.

Cook chicken. Pat cutlets dry; season with spice blend, salt and pepper. Heat 1 1/2 tbsp oil in a medium sauté pan over medium-high. Cook chicken 3 to 5 min per side until browned (it finishes later). Move to a plate; keep the pan.
Start couscous. Drizzle of oil in the same pan over medium. Add onions, salt and pepper; cook 4 to 5 min until softened. Add couscous; cook 1 to 2 min, stirring often.

Finish couscous. Stir in tomato cream sauce, stock concentrate and 1 1/4 cups water. Add chicken back, bring to a simmer, and cook 10 to 12 min until chicken hits 165°F and couscous is tender, shaking the pan now and then.
Plate. Top with olives and almonds, dollop tzatziki, squeeze lemon over. Serve with remaining lemon wedges.

title: Creamy paprika shrimp
steps: Prep. Trim green beans. Roughly chop pecans if needed.
Season shrimp. Rinse and pat dry. In a bowl, toss with smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp salt, a pinch of pepper and 2 tsp olive oil.

Green beans. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a medium sauté pan over medium. Add beans, 1/4 tsp salt and pepper; cook about 2 min until they start to soften. Carefully add 1/4 cup water; cook 3 to 5 min until it's cooked off and beans start to brown. Add pecans and 1 tbsp butter; cook 2 to 3 min until beans are tender and pecans toasted. Remove from heat.

Shrimp. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a large sauté pan over medium. Cook shrimp 2 to 3 min until mostly cooked. Add tomato sauce, cream cheese and 2 tbsp water; stir until the cream cheese melts. Simmer 4 to 5 min until thick and creamy and shrimp hit 145°F.
Slaw. Toss cabbage with basil vinaigrette to taste; season with salt and pepper.
Plate. Shrimp with green beans and slaw on the side.

title: Fajita turkey bowls with polenta
steps: Prep. Mince garlic. Dice bell pepper (1/4 inch). Thinly slice scallions, whites and greens separate.

Start turkey. Drizzle of oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high. Add garlic, bell pepper, scallion whites and onions; cook 4 to 6 min until pepper softens. Add turkey, stock concentrates and fajita spice; cook 4 to 5 min, breaking it up, until fully cooked (165°F).
Finish turkey. Stir in adobo tomatoes and 1/4 cup water. Simmer gently 3 to 4 min until reduced.

Polenta. In a small pot over medium, combine polenta and 1/2 cup water. Mash 30 to 60 sec until mostly smooth. Whisk 2 to 3 min until simmering and thick. Off heat, stir in 1 tbsp butter, season, and cover to keep warm.
Plate. Polenta topped with turkey, scallion greens, pepitas and cotija, drizzled with chimichurri.

title: Baked shrimp fra diavolo
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Warm oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium; cook garlic and pepper flakes 1 min.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper; simmer 10 min.
Nestle in shrimp, dot with butter, bake 8 to 10 min until opaque and 145°F.
Finish with Parmesan, herbs and lemon. Serve with bread or pasta.

title: Baked spicy sausage rigatoni
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; boil salted water.
Brown sausage in oil 8-10 min to 160°F. Add onion 4 min, then garlic and pepper flakes 1 min.
Add tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 15 min. Stir in butter; taste for salt and heat.
Cook pasta 2 min short of box time; drain. Toss with sauce and half the Parmesan.
Spread in a 9x13 plus an 8x8 (or one large roasting pan). Top with mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Bake 15-20 min until bubbling and browned. Finish with herbs.

title: Beef skillet with cheesy cauli topping
steps: Prep: bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Trim and peel shallot; halve and small dice (about 1/4 inch). Mince chives.

Start cauliflower mash: add cauliflower rice to boiling water; cook 4-5 min until very tender. Turn off heat, strain, shake off excess water, return to pot. Let sit 5 min on the warm (turned off) burner so the water evaporates.
Cook veggies: heat a drizzle of oil in a medium sauté pan over medium-high. Add shallot and carrots; season with salt and pepper. Cook 3-4 min until carrots are fork-tender.

Cook beef: add ground beef and a little more oil. Season with the rosemary, basil and sage blend, salt and pepper. Cook 5-6 min, breaking it up, until cooked through (160°F). Add peas, umami stock concentrates and about 2 tbsp water; stir. Remove from heat; season to taste.
Finish mash: add sour cream, white cheddar and 1 tbsp butter to the cauliflower. Season and mash until smooth.
Finish skillet: spread mash over the beef and veggies in an even layer. Garnish with chives.
Divide between plates.

title: Shrimp and spaghetti squash primavera
steps: Roast squash: preheat oven to 450°F. Halve spaghetti squash if needed and scoop out seeds. Drizzle insides with 1-2 tbsp oil; season with 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/4 tsp salt and pepper. Roast cut side down on a lightly oiled, foil-lined baking sheet 20-25 min, until strands separate easily with a fork.
Season shrimp: rinse and pat dry. In a medium bowl, season with 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/4 tsp salt and pepper. Drizzle with 1 tbsp oil and stir. Let sit at least 10 min.
Prep: small dice the Roma tomato (about 1/4 inch).
Toast seeds: toast sunflower seeds in a dry medium sauté pan over medium heat 3-4 min, stirring often, until fragrant. Cool and roughly chop.
Cook shrimp: melt 1 tbsp butter in the same pan over medium-high. Add shrimp and cook 5-6 min, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked (145°F). Move to a plate.

Make sauce: bring about 1/4 cup water to a simmer in the shrimp pan over medium-high; simmer 2-3 min until reduced by about a third. Off heat, whisk in cream cheese. Return shrimp, stir to coat, season to taste.

Finish squash: separate strands from the peel with a fork (use tongs or an oven mitt; it's hot). Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large sauté pan over medium. Add squash strands, tomato, peas, about half the Parmesan and 1/4 cup water. Cook 3-4 min until cheese melts and veggies are warm. Season to taste.
Plate: divide squash and veggies between bowls, top with creamy shrimp and any remaining sauce. Garnish with sunflower seeds, remaining Parmesan and chili flakes to taste.
